topics_covered: Transthyretin (ATTR) cardiac amyloidosis: diagnosis, prevalence, screening, nonbiopsy diagnostic approaches, imaging accuracy, and treatment (e.g., tafamidis).
Cardiac amyloidosis in the context of severe aortic stenosis and transcatheter aortic valve replacement.
Specific TTR variant V122I mentioned in relation to ATTR.

Associated Conditions: Hereditary ATTR associated with V122I mutation
genes.context: Multiple references discuss transthyretin (TTR) in the context of cardiac amyloidosis (e.g., refs 971, 972, 975, 977) including mention of ATTR, wild-type transthyretin, and V122I mutations (ref 977).
